title: 国家党赢最多席位：选民支持反被侵蚀，纽元小幅走高能持续吗？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: At the same time, we also had an election in New Zealand over the weekend and it's been quite interesting.
segments.zh: 与此同时，周末新西兰也举行了大选，情况相当有趣。

segments.en: If you take a look at that reaction in the Kiwi Dollar, it's edging higher in the early part of the Asia session, the National Party emerging with something resembling a path back to power.
segments.zh: 看看纽元的表现，在亚洲时段早盘小幅走高，国家党似乎有望重新掌权。

segments.en: So that outcome is marginally dollar sensitive, as you can see, the odds have been favouring the Centreright Coalition remaining in power there.
segments.zh: 这一结果对美元略有敏感，如你所见，此前市场预期中右翼联盟将继续执政。

segments.en: So, National winning more seats are then labour, although voters did really erode that level of support, strengthen the partners on the right.
segments.zh: 国家党赢得的席位多于工党，尽管选民确实削弱了其支持率，但强化了右翼伙伴。

segments.en: So it was a pretty closely fought election, but of course we continue to watch how it ultimately plays out when it comes to the shifting, to coalition negotiations,
segments.zh: 这是一场竞争激烈的大选，我们当然会继续关注最终结果，尤其是联盟谈判的进展，

segments.en: what the exact makeup of the next government looks like. But well, this was really a cost of living election that we saw and we continue to wait for sort of the details on what that looks like.
segments.zh: 以及下一届政府的具体构成。这确实是一场围绕生活成本的大选，我们仍在等待相关细节。
